title: Loudness make-up measured in the page when asked
description:
As a producer, I want the master make-up gain measured in the browser as the CLI does, so that the set opens at the loudness Apricity renders, and I want to skip it when I am in a hurry.

```gherkin
Feature: Loudness make-up in the browser export
  Scenario: Measured by default
    Given a score with a master loudness target of -14 LUFS
    When I choose "Download for your DAW"
    Then the page renders the score with the wasm renderer and measures the make-up gain
    And the set's main-track Utility carries the same gain the CLI export writes

  Scenario: Skipped
    When I choose "Download for your DAW" with "skip loudness" on
    Then no render happens and the Utility gain is 0 dB
```
